failures.summary: Premature termination and cell death due to pigment loss (white cells) observed across multiple runs (RUN-0001 at 82h, RUN-0003 at 84h, RUN-0004 at 74h).
Late-stage cell death and pigment loss observed in RUN-0002 (completed at 96h) and RUN-0005 (after ~108h).

trends.summary: Addition of 200 mL Isopropyl Myristate (IPM) at 24h in RUN-0005 delayed the onset of pigment loss and cell death until ~108h.
RUN-0006 maintained culture stability up to 120h with only a slight decrease in OD/WCW after 114h.

analysis.summary: Severe data truncation in observations.csv compared to narrative reports: RUN-0001 ends at 48h (reported 82h), RUN-0002 ends at 0h (reported 96h), RUN-0004 ends at 60h (reported 74h), and RUN-0006 ends at 96h (reported 120h).

narrative: The fermentation campaign experienced recurrent issues with late-stage cell death and pigment loss (appearance of white cells) across multiple runs. RUN-0001, RUN-0003, and RUN-0004 were prematurely terminated between 74h and 84h due to these issues. RUN-0002 and RUN-0005 also exhibited these symptoms but reached or neared their planned durations. An intervention in RUN-0005 (addition of 200 mL Isopropyl Myristate at 24h) successfully delayed the onset of cell death and pigment loss until ~108h. RUN-0006 showed the best stability, maintaining culture viability up to 120h with only a slight decrease in biomass after 114h. Notably, the numerical data provided in the observations dataset is severely truncated compared to the narrative reports, with RUN-0002 missing all data after 0h, and several other runs missing their final 14-34 hours of data, preventing quantitative analysis of the cell death events.
